newsitem.title: UK: Moorfield drops offer for Greycoat.
newsitem.headline: Moorfield drops offer for Greycoat.

text.p: British property develpment company Moorfield Estates Plc said on Saturday it will no longer proceed with its offer for larger rival Greycoat as it had been unable to pursue constructive discussions with the company.

"In the absence of a meaningful dialogue and a reasonable exchange of information, Moorfield believes that the risks of acquiring Greycoat outweigh the considerable benefits of the proposed merger," Moorfield said in a statement.
Last week, Greycoat denied a newspaper report that it had rejected merger proposals from Moorfield.
On December 5, Greycoat shareholders voted to reject a resolution calling for the sale of all its assets, a plan that had been put forward by the shareholder UK Active Value Fund (UKAV).

A Greycoat spokesman said the company was not surprised the offer had been called off. "Moorfield was never able to demonstrate it had a credible proposal. We now look forward to continuing to implement our stated strategy," he told Reuters.
